typography.statRowException: A 4-column stat row always uses sm tier regardless of height (label 24 / body 24).

statCardException.note: Cards with a dominant impact number (64px+) use 32px X padding instead of the tier default of 48px. Y padding (48px top/bottom) is unchanged.
statCardException.appliesWhen: heading or impact number is 64px or larger and dominates the card visually

body.note: The `body` node directly under the slide title is a subtitle: 32 Medium 134% Gray/500, positioned 15px below the title (y=200), full content width. NOT 20px — 20 is a legacy deviation. Source of truth: Template references pillar-grid-3up-* frames.

listRow.note: Tabular/list content. Uses its own smaller scale — one step below lg — so rows read tabular, not card-like.

cardMarker.note: Single marker at the top of a card; matches the card's label size.

denseMarker.note: Marker inside a bullet list, list-row, or stacked ordinal list; one typescale notch smaller than the surrounding body.

textNodeNaming.rule: Name text nodes by role, not content. Do not reuse 'label' for what is actually a 'heading'. Top-of-slide chrome is named 'meta-left' and 'meta-right' (NOT 'meta').

chromePositioning.note: Content is pinned at y=287 regardless of title length. Card height is always 745. Title→content gap is variable (~102 for 1-row title at 64/110%, ~32 for 2-row). No bottom meta — last content element's bottom edge lands at y=1032 (48px from slide bottom). Slot names are 'meta-left', 'meta-right', 'title' — applyChrome() writes these at the positions above.

impact.note: Step heading up one size on the typescale when content is a single dramatic number or 3-word punchy phrase. Max one impact element per card, max one hero per slide. The values below are concrete targets per tier.

template-title-center.description: Centered title only. For opening/closing slides with a single strong statement.
template-title-center.matchHints: Slide with only a short title, centered. No subtitle or body text. Use for opening or closing slides.

template-title-left.matchHints: Slide with only a short title, left-aligned. No subtitle or body text.

template-title-subtitle-center.description: Centered title with subtitle/body text below. For title slides that need a tagline or context.
template-title-subtitle-center.matchHints: Title slide with a subtitle or tagline. Centered layout. Good for cover slides.

template-title-subtitle-left.matchHints: Title slide with a subtitle or tagline. Left-aligned layout.

template-bullets-4.description: Title + 4 bullet points, each with heading and body text. 2x2 grid layout.
template-bullets-4.matchHints: Slide with 3-4 key points, each having a heading and short description. NOTE: bullet-body numbering may not match bullet-heading numbering in the Figma file (e.g., bullet-body-2 may belong to bullet-heading-3). Always find by name.

template-bullets-6.description: Title + 6 bullet points, each with heading and body text. 2x3 grid layout.

slots.name: bullet-body-3
slots.note: This is bullet 4's body — Figma names it bullet-body-3 (duplicate name). Use nodeId to target the correct one.

template-bullets-6.matchHints: Slide with 5-6 key points. Round up: 5 bullets should use this template. Note: bullet-body-3 name is duplicated in Figma for bullets 3 and 4 — use nodeId for bullet 4's body.

template-bullets-8.description: Title + 8 bullet points, each with heading and body text. 2x4 grid layout.
template-bullets-8.matchHints: Slide with 7-8 key points. Round up: 7 bullets should use this template.

template-technical-bullets.description: Title + intro text + up to 9 technical spec bullets in two columns with a large image area on the left. Each bullet has heading + body.
template-technical-bullets.matchHints: Technical specification slide. Use for product specs, feature lists with many items, or technical detail slides. Has a large image/bento area on the left half.

template-chapter-left.matchHints: Section divider / chapter break. Short heading only, no body text. Use to separate major sections.

template-chapter-center.matchHints: Section divider / chapter break. Centered. Short heading only.

template-chapter-right.matchHints: Section divider / chapter break. Right-aligned. Short heading only.

template-comparison-50-50.description: Title + body + two equal-width sections with headings and 4 points each. Side-by-side comparison in rounded cards.
template-comparison-50-50.matchHints: Side-by-side comparison of two things. Each side has a heading and up to 4 bullet points. Good for vs. slides, option comparisons.

template-bento-75-25.description: Title + body + two sections: large left (4 points) and small right (2 points). 75/25 split.
template-bento-75-25.matchHints: Asymmetric split: large left panel with more content, smaller right panel. Use when one topic is primary.

template-bento-25-75.description: Title + body + two sections: small left (2 points) and large right (4 points). 25/75 split.

slots.name: section-heading-2
slots.note: Second section heading — shares name 'section-heading-1' in Figma, so use nodeId

template-bento-25-75.matchHints: Asymmetric split: smaller left panel, large right panel with more content. Note: second section heading shares name with first — use nodeId.

template-bento-66-33.description: Title + body + two sections: larger left (4 points) and smaller right (2 points). 66/33 split.

slots.name: section-point-5
slots.note: Named 'section-point-1' in Figma (duplicate) — mapped as section-point-5 here

slots.name: section-point-6
slots.note: Named 'section-point-2' in Figma (duplicate) — mapped as section-point-6 here

template-bento-66-33.matchHints: Two-thirds / one-third split. Similar to 75-25 but more balanced. Note: section 2's points have duplicate names in Figma — use nodeId.

template-bento-33-66.description: Title + body + two sections: smaller left (2 points) and larger right (4 points). 33/66 split.

template-bento2.description: Title + body + 2 bento grid cells, each with heading and body.
template-bento2.matchHints: 2 items in a bento grid with image areas. Good for showcasing 2 features, products, or categories.

flexible.notes: Body slots on slide and cells are optional — hide when not needed. Cell headings can use impact typography for dramatic numbers or short phrases.

template-bento3.description: Title + body + 3 bento grid cells, each with heading and body.
template-bento3.matchHints: 3 items in a bento grid. Good for showcasing 3 features, pillars, or categories.

flexible.notes: Body slots are optional. Cell headings can use impact typography. When content has 3 items of any kind, this is a good default.

template-bento4.description: Title + body + 4 bento grid cells, each with heading and body.
template-bento4.matchHints: 4 items in a bento grid. Good for showcasing 4 features or categories.

flexible.notes: Body slots are optional. Cell headings can use impact typography.

template-bento5.description: Title + body + 5 bento grid cells, each with heading and body.

flexible.notes: Body slots are optional. Cell headings can use impact typography.

template-bento6.description: Title + body + 6 bento grid cells, each with heading and body.
template-bento6.matchHints: 6 items in a bento grid. Maximum density bento layout.

flexible.notes: Body slots are optional. Cell headings can use impact typography.

template-table-2columns.description: Title + 2-column comparison table. Rows use component instances (Row-title, Table-data). 6 data rows.

tableConfig.instructions: Table cells are component instances (Column-title, Row-title, Table-data). Each instance has one text child. Traverse into the instance children to find and set text. Row order: header row first, then data rows top to bottom. Column order: left to right (first column is Row-title / Category, remaining are Table-data).

template-table-2columns.matchHints: Data table with 2 columns. Good for simple comparisons, specifications, or feature lists.

template-table-3columns.description: Title + 3-column comparison table with header row and 6 data rows.

tableConfig.instructions: Same as table-2columns but with 3 data columns. First column is always Row-title (category), remaining 3 are Table-data.

template-table-3columns.matchHints: Data table with 3 columns. Good for comparing 3 options or competitors.

template-table-4columns.description: Title + 4-column comparison table with header row and 6 data rows.

tableConfig.instructions: Same structure. First column is Row-title (category), 3 remaining are Table-data. Header row uses Column-title instances.

template-table-4columns.matchHints: Data table with 4 columns. Good for detailed comparisons across multiple dimensions.

template-quote1-middle.description: Single quote with attribution, left-aligned in middle of slide.
template-quote1-middle.matchHints: Single testimonial or quote. Use when there is one quote with an author/source attribution.

template-quote2-middle.description: Two quotes side by side, each with attribution.
template-quote2-middle.matchHints: Two testimonials or quotes side by side. Use when there are exactly 2 quotes.

template-metrics-4.description: Title + body on left + 4 large metrics with labels in a 2x2 grid on the right.
template-metrics-4.matchHints: Slide showcasing 4 key numbers/metrics/KPIs. Use when there are 3-4 numerical stats to highlight (e.g., 99.99%, 50K+, 24h, $1.2M).

flexible.notes: Metric values always use impact typography. Hide unused metric slots. For 2-3 metrics, hide metric-4 and its label.

template-huge-fact.description: Single giant number or fact, centered. Maximum impact.
template-huge-fact.matchHints: One single dramatic number or short fact. For maximum visual impact. E.g., 'XX%' or '$2.1B'.

template-huge-fact-eyebrow.description: Giant number/fact with small eyebrow text above it.
template-huge-fact-eyebrow.matchHints: Dramatic number with a small label/context above. E.g., eyebrow='Revenue growth' metric='47%'.

template-huge-fact-body.description: Giant number/fact with explanatory body text below.
template-huge-fact-body.matchHints: Dramatic number with explanation below. E.g., metric='99.99%' body='PFAS removal rate, independently verified'.

template-info-left-top.description: Eyebrow + title + body text, positioned top-left.
template-info-left-top.matchHints: Informational slide with a category label (eyebrow), title, and body. Top-left positioning.

template-info-left-middle.description: Title + body text, positioned middle-left. The most versatile fallback template.
template-info-left-middle.matchHints: General-purpose informational slide. Title + body text. FALLBACK TEMPLATE: use this when no other template is a good fit.

template-info-left-bottom.matchHints: Informational slide. Title + body. Bottom-left positioning.

template-info-center-center.description: Eyebrow + title + body text, centered on slide.
template-info-center-center.matchHints: Centered informational slide with category label, title, and body text.

template-info-2bullets.description: Title + body text on left + 2 bullet points on right.
template-info-2bullets.matchHints: Info slide with description on left and 2 supporting points on right.

template-info-3bullets.description: Title + body text on left + 3 bullet points on right.
template-info-3bullets.matchHints: Info slide with description on left and 3 supporting points on right.

template-info-4bullets.description: Title + body text on left + 4 bullet points on right.
template-info-4bullets.matchHints: Info slide with description on left and 4 supporting points on right.

template-info-split-top.description: Eyebrow + title + body, top-aligned with a split layout.
template-info-split-top.matchHints: Informational split layout. Category label + title + body text. Top positioning.

template-product-2.description: Title + 2 product cards, each with image area, product name, and description.
template-product-2.matchHints: Showcase 2 products with names and descriptions. Has image placeholder areas.

template-product-3.description: Title + 3 product cards, each with image area, product name, and description.
template-product-3.matchHints: Showcase 3 products with names and descriptions. Has image placeholder areas.

template-logo-garden-3x3.description: Title + 3x3 grid of logo placeholder areas. For partner/client logos.
template-logo-garden-3x3.matchHints: Grid of logos/partner badges. Use for 'Our Partners', 'Trusted by', or client logo slides. Images must be added manually in Phase 2.

template-pricing-bento.description: Bento grid pricing slide. 6-unit grid, 2 rows. Title cell + 3 price cards (with optional badge) + blue hero hook cell + 2 offer cells. 32px radius, 32px gaps, 64/80px padding.
template-pricing-bento.matchHints: Pricing slide with bento grid layout. Use for pricing tiers + promotional hooks. Row 1: title + price cards. Row 2: blue hero hook + additional offers. Green badge on best-value tier.

flexible.notes: Price values should use impact typography (48-80px). Number of price tiers and offers can vary — build from scratch using the grid system if count differs from template.

template-timeline-bento.description: Bento grid timeline. 5-unit grid, 3 rows. Title cell (2-wide) + milestone cards + blue hero center cell (3-wide, 2-tall) + dark closing card. 32px radius/gaps, 64/80px padding.
template-timeline-bento.matchHints: Timeline with bento grid layout. Use for project timelines, roadmaps, critical paths. Blue hero cell highlights the key moment. Dark card for closing milestone. Each cell uses eyebrow (date) + heading (task) pattern.

flexible.notes: Milestone count can vary. Always include one hero cell (blue, 3u×2rows) for the key moment and optionally a dark closing card. Build from scratch when item count differs.

template-timeline-horizontal.description: Horizontal timeline with gray cards. 80px title, horizontal line with blue dots, date labels above dots, gray cards below. 5 steps. 32px radius, no shadows, 64/80px padding.
template-timeline-horizontal.matchHints: Horizontal timeline for sequential steps or next actions. Use for 'What happens now', 'Next steps', or any 4-8 step process. Date/number labels above dots, content in gray cards below. White background.

flexible.notes: Step count is flexible (3-8). Build from scratch with correct number of dots, labels, and cards. Body copy per card is optional — hide when heading alone is clear enough.

template-timeline-cards.description: Title + 8-step timeline with date labels above dots and gray cards below. Similar to timeline-horizontal but with 8 steps and more compact cards. Good for critical paths and detailed roadmaps.
template-timeline-cards.matchHints: 8-step timeline with date labels and cards. Use for critical paths, detailed project roadmaps, or phased rollouts with 6-8 milestones. More compact than timeline-horizontal — fits more steps.

flexible.notes: Step count is flexible (5-10). Build from scratch for different counts. Body copy per card is optional.

template-checklist-bento.description: Bento grid checklist. Title card (top-left) + 7 item cards with headings and deadlines. Last card is dark for the final/most critical item. 2 rows, mixed card sizes.
template-checklist-bento.matchHints: Checklist or task list with deadlines. Use for pre-launch checklists, action item lists, deliverables tracking, or any set of 5-8 tasks with due dates. Title card describes the checklist, item cards show tasks. Dark card for the final critical item.

flexible.notes: Item count is flexible (4-8). Build from scratch for different counts. Deadlines are optional. Last card should use dark background for emphasis.

split-portrait.description: 50/50 layout: text content on the left (label/body), full-bleed photo on the right.
split-portrait.matchHints: Testimonial, person, place, before/after. 50/50 image + text. Title fits 2 rows at 880 width.

bento-mix-center-hero.description: Multi-card bento with center-column hero image. 4-6 mixed cards (text, color-block stat, image).
bento-mix-center-hero.matchHints: 4-6 distinct items where one image is the hero centerpiece. Mixes text, color-block stats, and image cards.

pillar-grid-4up-image.description: 4 equal columns, each = full-bleed image card with label/heading/body text below.
pillar-grid-4up-image.matchHints: 4 distinct items of equal weight, each with a label/heading/body. Image-rich. Body copy may be hidden per item.

pillar-grid-3up-functional.description: 3 equal columns with functional product imagery + caption.
pillar-grid-3up-functional.matchHints: 3 functional product offerings (Energy, Hydrate, Zen pattern). Image-led.

pillar-grid-3up-product.description: 3 equal columns each showing a product (image + label/heading + sub).
pillar-grid-3up-product.matchHints: 3 products of equal weight. Use when items have a common visual treatment.
pillar-grid-3up-product.legacyNodes: Stale text nodes from copy-paste have been quarantined with '_legacy_' prefix (Beverage Description / Beverage title / Button / Dash / Flavor / Ingredients). Slot finder must skip names starting with '_legacy_'.

pillar-grid-3up-product-with-body.description: 3 equal product columns with full label/heading/body stack (longer copy variant).
pillar-grid-3up-product-with-body.matchHints: Same shape as pillar-grid-3up-product but with body copy per item. Use when each product needs a fuller description.

pillar-grid-3up-pricing.description: 3 product columns with pricing — image + heading/body + add-ons + price (rent/buy) + service caption.
pillar-grid-3up-pricing.matchHints: Pricing-tiered product slide. 3 products with rent/buy pricing, add-ons, service info.
pillar-grid-3up-pricing.legacyNodes: Stale text nodes from copy-paste have been quarantined with '_legacy_' prefix (Beverage Description / Beverage title / Button / Dash / Flavor / Ingredients). Slot finder must skip names starting with '_legacy_'.

numbered-list.description: Numbered list with marker (01, 02...) + heading + body per row. Best for install/service/process steps.
numbered-list.matchHints: Numbered process or step list. Replaces info-bullet templates when content has a clear sequential structure.

closing-pure-title.description: Closing/CTA slide with title at y=400 (centered), CTAs and contact info below.
closing-pure-title.chromeException: title.y=400 (intentional, centered closing slide; not a chrome-drift bug)
closing-pure-title.matchHints: Closing/CTA slide. Big centered title with contact details.

split-portrait-product-family.description: Half-width title on left, 4 product images stacked on right with cell-heading/body per item.
split-portrait-product-family.matchHints: Product family overview. Title + brief description on left, list of 4 product images with names on right.

pillar-grid-large-image.description: Multi-flavor showcase grid (7+ items, each = small image card with name + tagline).
pillar-grid-large-image.matchHints: Variety/flavor showcase with 7+ items. No slide title (title text exists as 'Ingredients.' free text).
pillar-grid-large-image.note: No 'title' slot — the visible title text is named 'Ingredients.' Custom layout with 9 image slots.

full-bleed-tech-hero.description: Full-bleed image with technology branding overlay (large product/feature name + tagline).
full-bleed-tech-hero.matchHints: Technology/feature showcase with full-bleed atmospheric image. Custom title overlay (not a 'title' slot).
full-bleed-tech-hero.note: Title text is two text nodes ('SuperiorOsmosis' + tagline) overlaid on the image, not named 'title'.

pentagrid-right.description: 1 dominant hero card on the right (impact stat + image) + 3 stacked supporting cards on the left.
pentagrid-right.matchHints: One dominant idea + 3 supporting points. Hero stat (e.g., 99.7%) on right, stat cards on left.
pentagrid-right.note: No slide-level title — the title text lives inside the top-left card. Custom slot vocabulary inside cards.

full-bleed-hero.description: Image fills entire slide. Eyebrow + 2-line title + body anchored bottom-left. Chapter dividers, dramatic statements.
full-bleed-hero.matchHints: Chapter divider or dramatic single-statement slide. Title bottom-left over full-bleed image. Title position is custom (NOT y=115).
full-bleed-hero.note: Title is anchored bottom-left over the image, not at canonical y=115. The image is the slide.

bento-3up-delivery.description: 3-column bento with image cards + cell-heading/cell-body each.
bento-3up-delivery.matchHints: 3 distinct items with imagery and dense per-item copy.

cover-with-product.description: Cover slide with full-bleed product imagery + subtitle + title. Variant of cover used as opening slide.
cover-with-product.matchHints: Opening cover slide with strong product visual. No meta-left (slide treats imagery as the brand cue).
cover-with-product.note: Stale text nodes 'Beverage Description', 'Beverage title', 'Button', 'Dash', 'Flavor', 'Ingredients' present from copy-paste — should be cleaned up in a Phase B follow-up.
cover-with-product.legacyNodes: Stale text nodes from copy-paste have been quarantined with '_legacy_' prefix (Beverage Description / Beverage title / Button / Dash / Flavor / Ingredients). Slot finder must skip names starting with '_legacy_'.

data-viz-bar-chart.description: Comparison bar chart with vertical bars + numeric labels above + category labels below.
data-viz-bar-chart.matchHints: Bar-chart comparison of N items with one numeric metric each. Best when content is 'X has more/less Y than Z'. Up to ~8 bars.
data-viz-bar-chart.note: Bars and per-bar labels are inside the chart frame; the registry slot list only covers slide-level chrome and title. Bar values must be edited in Figma manually OR via a chart-specific helper (out of scope today).

unit-economics-3up.description: 3-column unit economics breakdown. Each column = a stakeholder / pricing scenario with stat values and labels. One column highlighted with a colored gradient bg.
unit-economics-3up.matchHints: Single-drink / per-unit pricing breakdown across 2-3 stakeholders. Best for pricing logic explanations where each column is a stakeholder view.
unit-economics-3up.note: Column slots use custom text node names (Single drink, 10-drink card, $X.XX, per drink, etc.) — registry-listed slots cover only chrome. Per-column values fill via direct nodeId references when generating.

unit-economics-3up-scaling.description: 3-column revenue-projection scaling. Each column = a scale tier (100, 500, 1000 locations) with revenue and profit numbers.
unit-economics-3up-scaling.matchHints: Scale-projection slide: same metric across 3 scenarios. Best for 'at N units this is Y revenue' framings.
unit-economics-3up-scaling.note: Has a footnote text at y=1023 ('Based on... per drink'). Per-column $ values via nodeId references.

cover-hero-large.description: Alt cover slide: full-bleed atmospheric image, large hero subtitle (96 SB) bottom-left, logo top-left, meta-right top-right.
cover-hero-large.matchHints: Opening cover with hero typography on atmospheric image. Use when the deck wants a dramatic, single-line cover statement instead of the 'product cover' style.
cover-hero-large.note: No 'title' slot — uses 'subtitle' (96 SB Semi Bold) as the hero text. Logo is a separate frame at (48,48). Variant of cover-with-product.
